positions.title: Software Development Engineer - Alexa, Amazon Echo, Fire Phone
Lead Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for developing and deploying software across iOS and Android platforms in their native languages, for example:

* Develop and resolve code,layout and feature issues related to Android Fragmentation
* Develop new features on existing code bases
* Assist in iOS code development
* Repository Management
* Develop on a strict iteration schedule
* Code new features using the Android NDK
* Pair Code Reviews
* Responsible for self unit testing, debugging and Quality Assurance
* Delicious beer
* Tools: IntelliJ/Android Studio, XCode,Monkey Runner, JUnit, Selenium, XCTest, bottle opener

positions.title: Production Division / Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for Game application development and prototyping across the stack.  

* Feasibility studies with prototype games for research and development
* Upgrade existing client-side frameworks for future game development
* Create and debug existing client and server side code
* Tools: Intellij, Microsoft Visual Studio, Selenium, Zend Framework, Java, Objective-C, C++
* World Wide inter-studio communication and cooperation from studios outside of Tokyo, Japan
* Play Video games!

positions.title: Programmer / Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for developing, updating and maintaining applications for PC and mobile clients in Japan as well as server/database setup and administration . Primary application targets for web applications are mobile however, parent applications often had PC sister applications or background server APIs. Coding was done using PHP, Java, JavaScript and HTML/HTML5 and/or ASP. Native applications required Java for Android and Objective-C for IOS devices. Servers ranged from in-house to Cloud (Amazon-ec2 / kddi cloud) servers depending on client needs and expediency. 

Projects were versioned using GIT/SVN depending on requirements.

Server software programmed/compiled in C++

* Lead Developer for front and back end technology across the stack
* Responsible for metrics and performance on backend servers
* Built Game API's with Php, MySQL, EC2
* Created front end games using ActionScript 3
* Developed example applications in iOS, Android with EC2 backend
* Coded mobile applications for Japan's native mobile web technology: I-Mode, EzWeb, Yahoo protocols 
* B2B and B2C applications development
* Created backend code for Facebook applications
* Clients included Nespresso Japan, Porsche, Volvo Japan, Nikon and Merial Japan
* Involved in Promotion planning, program flow, feasibility studies, coding and QA

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for development of applications relating to B2B and B2C relations
* Lead Programmer for mobile and web development
* Coded mobile applications for Japan's native mobile web technology: I-Mode, EzWeb, Yahoo protocols
* Developed a custom back-end server CMS
